klaim.halaman: Bagian 3.3 dan Gambar 8, h. 11; batasan di Bagian 2.4, h. 7
klaim.bukti: with an increase in the number of restrictions, the statistics steadily neared the actual value, and the average accuracy of each row gradually increased to 96.82%.
klaim.catatan: Pisang, RGB-D, DeepSORT, tiga batasan, dan 96,82% sesuai. Naskah sumber hanya membandingkan empat kondisi batasan pada DeepSORT; tidak ada pembanding pelacak lain. Angka 96,82% adalah rerata akurasi per baris dari enam baris (61 tandan).

klaim.halaman: Tabel 12, h. 16-17; abstrak, h. 1; Tabel 5, h. 6
klaim.bukti: The Leave-Site-Out 5-fold cross-validation demonstrates the model's generalization ability on unseen geographical sites in a rigorous manner, producing accuracies of between 93.73% and 95.14% (mean: 94.66% ± 0.54%
klaim.perbaikan: Replace 96.54% with 94.66% (± 0.54%, Leave-Site-Out 5-fold cross-validation). Suggested wording: "used 10,000 photographs (8,000 for training) from five Indonesian plantation sites in four classes and reported 94.66% ± 0.54% accuracy under leave-site-out cross-validation on sites not seen in training".
klaim.catatan: Angka 96,54% tidak ada di sumber; tampaknya gabungan keliru dari 94,66% dan ± 0,54%. Bagian 10.000 foto, lima lokasi, dan empat kelas sesuai abstrak, tetapi data latih hanya 8.000 dari 10.000 citra (Tabel 5). Sumber juga tidak konsisten: Tabel 3 menyebut 3 perkebunan (7.000 citra lapangan) ditambah 3.000 citra Roboflow. Klaim 'the largest study in the corpus' adalah pernyataan tinjauan, tidak diperiksa di sini.

klaim.bukti: OC-SORT, with incorporated optical flow, achieved the best performance on the validation dataset, with HOTA = 0.59, MOTA = 0.52, and IDF1 = 0.67
klaim.catatan: Apel, kamera stereo, GPS dan visual odometry, OC-SORT lawan ByteTrack, galat total 20 apel, RMSE 6,24%, dan R2 0,96 semuanya ada di abstrak. Galat hitung dilaporkan untuk pohon Elstar; HOTA diukur pada data validasi.

klaim.bukti: combining Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with a bipartite graph matching has the potential to address those challenges. We found that our approach applied to real-world datasets, with unconstrained camera motion and low frame rates, outperforms existing methods
klaim.catatan: SfM, bipartite graph matching, gerak kamera bebas, dan laju bingkai rendah sesuai abstrak; apel sesuai judul.

klaim.bukti: Three MOT algorithms-SORT, DeepSORT, and ByteTrack-were evaluated [...] ByteTrack achieved exceptional performance with MOTA, HOTA, and IDF1 ratings of 59.67 %, 65.42%, and 73.72% respectively.
klaim.catatan: Calamansi, video drone, tiga pelacak, dan ketiga angka sesuai abstrak. Abstrak tidak melaporkan galat hitung, sehingga label 'Identity' tepat.
